selection_rationale.objective: Prefer one dense point-in-time session-end activity mechanism that is economically different from return paths, nominal price discreteness, broad late-window activity, accounting operators, and old-factor combinations.
selection_rationale.economic_anchor: The fraction of completed-session CNY turnover concentrated in the provider's terminal 15:00 one-minute bucket measures session-end liquidity clustering. It is a terminal-bar concentration measure only and must not be described as a dedicated closing-auction order, imbalance, or trade feed.

rejected_before_values.reason: The current data authorization does not include a separate closing-auction feed; the frozen raw source exposes only standard one-minute OHLCV amount bars, so no auction-only identity may be inferred.
Choosing among alternative tail windows would create an unfrozen parameter search and overlaps the terminal late_amount_share_30m definition.
Selecting units or blending amount and volume would create a family search; only CNY amount share is selected.
Benchmark choice and lookback length would add transforms and multi-session parameters not authorized for Campaign074.
Campaign073 exposed nominal price affordability and failed near price-update share; further price-discreteness permutations are same-family search.
Campaign066-Campaign072 already exposed a finite accounting-operator library; another permutation would be same-family search.
Subsets, thresholds, neutralization, terminal-factor inputs, fitted weights, and models are outside Campaign074.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_terminal_bar_amount_share_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A greater completed-session amount concentration in the terminal minute bucket may identify persistent session-end attention and liquidity demand whose state carries from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: For every accepted stock day, require the exact 240 continuous-session amount bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, require every amount to be finite and nonnegative and their sum S to be positive, and return amount_15:00/S.
selected_candidate.accepted_grid: Exactly 120 amount bars at 09:31-11:30 and 120 at 13:01-15:00; standalone 09:30 is preserved in the raw 241-row source identity but excluded from numerator and denominator.
selected_candidate.terminal_anchor: Exactly the provider's 15:00 one-minute amount bucket; it is not relabeled as a separately licensed closing-auction feed.
selected_candidate.normalization_rule: Divide the nonnegative finite 15:00 amount by the positive sum of all exact 240 selected amount bars.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing unless the exact 240-bar selected grid exists, every selected amount is finite and nonnegative, the selected total is strictly positive, the identity is unique, and the ratio is finite in [0,1]. Never impute, clip, winsorize, substitute, threshold, rescale, or select another tail window.
